title: Steal a car
instruction: Enter an automobile as its driver and remain in the driver seat for two seconds. Choose the vehicle, route, approach, entry attempts and recovery yourself. Bicycles and motorcycles do not satisfy this goal.
setup: Start on foot outdoors near a reachable road, using the opening New Game alley or a manually staged free-roam save with --reset none. The agent can leave the alley and look for traffic; no car is spawned.
